arxiv-2004-08650.creator: Fabien Le Floc’h
arxiv-2004-08650.description: Abstract This paper presents simple formulae for the local variance gamma model of Carr and Nadtochiy, extended with a piecewise-linear local variance function. The new formulae allow to calibrate the model efficiently to market option quotes. On a small set of quotes, exact calibration is achieved under one millisecond.

arxiv-2112-10178.title: Off-shell Supersymmetric Continuous Spin Gauge Theory
arxiv-2112-10178.creator: Mojtaba
arxiv-2112-10178.description: Abstract IPM/P-2021/42 We construct, for the first time, an off-shell supersymmetric continuous spin gauge theory in 4-dimensional Minkowski spacetime, in both constrained and unconstrained Lagrangian formulations. As an extension to the on-shell description [ 1 ] , we employ an auxiliary field to close the algebra of supersymmetry transformations off-shell.

arxiv-2504-07544.title: SeparationPINN: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Seismic P- and S-Wave Mode Separation
arxiv-2504-07544.creator: Xinru Mu, Shijun Cheng, Tariq Alkhalifah
arxiv-2504-07544.description: Abstract Accurate separation of P- and S-waves is essential for multi-component seismic data processing, as it helps eliminate interference between wave modes during imaging or inversion, which leads to high-accuracy results. Traditional methods for separating P- and S-waves rely on the Christoffel equation to compute the polarization direction of the waves in the wavenumber domain, which is computationally expensive.

arxiv-2506-12320.title: The Foundation Cracks: A Comprehensive Study on Bugs and Testing Practices in LLM Libraries
arxiv-2506-12320.creator: Weipeng Jiang 1 , Xiaoyu Zhang 1,4 , Xiaofei Xie 2 , Jiongchi Yu 2 , Yuhan Zhi 1 , Shiqing Ma 3 , Chao Shen 1
arxiv-2506-12320.description: Abstract Large Language Model (LLM) libraries have emerged as the foundational infrastructure powering today’s AI revolution, serving as the backbone for LLM deployment, inference optimization, fine-tuning, and production serving across diverse applications. Despite their critical role in the LLM ecosystem, these libraries face frequent quality issues and bugs that threaten the reliability of AI systems built upon them.

arxiv-2509-18875.creator: Marta Cipriani, Marco Alfò, Mirko Signorelli
arxiv-2509-18875.description: Abstract Mixture cure models are widely used in survival analysis when a portion of patients is considered cured and is no longer at risk for the event of interest. arxiv-2511-20088.title: Explainable Visual Anomaly Detection via Concept Bottleneck Models
arxiv-2511-20088.creator: Arianna Stropeni, Valentina Zaccaria, Francesco Borsatti, Davide Dalle Pezze, Manuel Barusco, Gian Antonio Susto
arxiv-2511-20088.description: Abstract In recent years, Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) has gained significant attention due to its ability to identify anomalous images using only normal images during training. Many VAD models work without supervision but are still able to provide visual explanations by highlighting the anomalous regions within an image.

arxiv-2601-22833.title: Are Bell’s conditions for local realism general enough ?
arxiv-2601-22833.creator: Emilio Santos
arxiv-2601-22833.description: Abstract Bell conditions for local realism are critically revisited. In particular for optical experiments I criticize Bell’s proposed response of detectors to signals as extremely idealized. More physical conditions are proposed, whence a realistic local model of an optical experiment is possible which violates the Clauser-Horne (Bell) inequality.

pmc-10743632.title: Somatotype Analysis of International Football Players with Cerebral Palsy: A Comparison with Non-Disabled Football Players
pmc-10743632.creator: Carmen Doménech, Enrique Roche, Raul Reina, José Manuel Sarabia, Giuseppe Musumeci
pmc-10743632.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Football for people with cerebral palsy is a para-sport involving ambulant athletes with impairments, such as hypertonia, ataxia, or athetosis. The objective of the present study was to describe the somatotype of a representative sample of international football players according to different functional profiles of cerebral palsy, including spastic diparesis, athetosis/ataxia, spastic hemiparesis, and minimum impairment criteria, and to compare it with non-disabled football players.

A descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted among the parents and guardians of primary school students. A 23-item questionnaire was developed on the basis of previous studies.

pmc-11673523.description: Bone matrix exhibits exceptional mechanical properties due to its unique nanocomposite structure of type I collagen fibrils and hydroxyapatite (HAp) nanoparticles in hierarchical liquid crystalline (LC) order. pmc-12529030.description: Introduction/AimsThere is a lack of up‐to‐date information on the burden of motor neuron diseases (MNDs) in the United States (US). pmc-12606308.creator: Shanbin Zheng, Jiaqing Zhu, Xun Cao, Zhiyuan Chen, Chao Zhang, Tianwei Xia, Jirong Shen
pmc-12606308.description: Exposure to volatile organic compounds (VOCs) is widespread and has been implicated in the pathogenesis of various chronic diseases. This study aimed to investigate the associations between a broad spectrum of VOC metabolites and OA risk, and to identify the most influential VOC metabolites.

pmc-13566706.creator: Robert Balan, Parwis Massoudy, Marius Mihai Harpa, Klara Brînzaniuc, Jonah Schwarz
pmc-13566706.description: Background: Minimally invasive cardiac valve surgery (MIVS) provides distinct clinical advantages, yet annular suturing remains a technically demanding step. This study evaluates the initial clinical feasibility, technical safety, and operational integration of automated suturing during its institutional adoption phase.
